title: Resize to three sizes
vague: I need this in the right sizes for socials

answers.which: square post, story, and a wide banner
answers.keep: the design and every word; it should fill each size properly, not be padded or stretched

full: Deliver this poster in three sizes: 1:1 for a feed post, 9:16 for a story, 16:9 for a banner. Each one must fill its frame: re-lay out the design so the artwork and every word fit the new shape naturally; keep the style, colours and all the lettering exactly; no stretching, and no letterboxing bars.
note: pure ffmpeg; the MCP has no resize
